scope: A deterministic wording screen, not a gold annotation of temporal intent. Only visible question strings enter the classifier.
decision: Assign a category only when exactly one cue family matches. Multiple families become mixed_cues. No cue becomes unspecified_or_ambiguous.
limitations: Words such as from, between, and during do not uniquely specify a logical predicate.
Event words can occur in unrelated noun phrases. The screen measures wording, not semantic accuracy.
No annotation strings, reference answers, or reader responses are read.
The existing evaluation uses its frozen somewhere-within predicate for every parsed question.
